sources.title: Invented offline evaluation run A
sources.content: Run A used invented tickets. The synthetic assistant escalated 97 of 100 policy-sensitive cases. Two false negatives remained. Results do not establish production readiness.

assertions.quote: The synthetic assistant escalated 97 of 100 policy-sensitive cases.
Results do not establish production readiness.

sources.title: Invented independent offline replay B
sources.content: Independent replay on a separate invented dataset reproduced a 97 percent escalation rate. The replay was offline and contained no customer data.

assertions.quote: Independent replay on a separate invented dataset reproduced a 97 percent escalation rate.
